topic.title: Sparse Regression and Structured Regularization
topic.area: Sparsity, Low-Rank Models, and Dimensionality Reduction
topic.overview: Sparse regression identifies a small set of useful coefficients, sometimes organized into groups or other structures. This topic develops penalties, optimization schemes, screening rules, and recovery guarantees for such models. Safe screening is a distinctive theme: it removes features only when they can be certified inactive at the optimum.
topic.whyItMatters: Sparsity can improve interpretability and computation, but penalty choices can introduce bias and correlated features can complicate selection. Efficient algorithms need to distinguish provably unnecessary variables from those that merely look weak during early iterations.
topic.evolution: The collection spans early sparse polynomial construction and regularized regression. Later work develops structured penalties, robust Lasso variants, and dual-gap screening. Recent examples address dependent time series and reuse sparse recovery for selecting interpretable editing directions, often pairing support selection with a separate debiasing step.
openQuestions: How should sparse selections reflect uncertainty among correlated alternatives?
Which screening guarantees extend to nonconvex penalties or dependent observations?

papers.title: Scaled Least Squares Estimator for GLMs in Large-Scale Problems
papers.tldr: Approximate proportionality between GLM and least squares coefficients enables cheaper estimation with maximum-likelihood accuracy in the studied large-data regime.

papers.title: Selective inference for group-sparse linear models
papers.tldr: A distributional result enables confidence intervals and p-values for groups selected by several group-sparse modeling methods.

papers.title: Split LBI: An Iterative Regularization Path with Structural Sparsity
papers.tldr: Split LBI combines variable splitting and iterative regularization, with conditional model-selection guarantees and reported advantages over generalized Lasso.

papers.title: Structured Sparse Regression via Greedy Hard Thresholding
papers.tldr: Submodular optimization avoids NP-hard projections in overlapping-group regression, yielding strong guarantees and large empirical speedups.

papers.title: Approximate Steepest Coordinate Descent
papers.tldr: A new coordinate-selection rule provably improves on uniform sampling and can approach steepest coordinate descent efficiency at little practical overhead.

papers.title: Doubly Greedy Primal-Dual Coordinate Descent for Sparse Empirical Risk Minimization
papers.tldr: A primal-dual coordinate method exploits sparsity on both sides of the optimization problem, with conditional linear convergence and reported speedups up to thirtyfold.

papers.title: GSOS: Gauss-Seidel Operator Splitting Algorithm for Multi-Term Nonsmooth Convex Composite Optimization
papers.tldr: GSOS combines Gauss-Seidel updates and operator splitting, with global convergence analysis and strong results on two Lasso problems.

papers.title: Latent Feature Lasso
papers.tldr: Atomic-norm regularization enables latent feature estimation with polynomial runtime and sample complexity.

papers.title: Sketched Ridge Regression: Optimization Perspective, Statistical Perspective, and Model Averaging
papers.tldr: Sketching can increase ridge regression's bias or variance, while model averaging substantially reduces the resulting statistical risk.

papers.title: Sparse + Group-Sparse Dirty Models: Statistical Guarantees without Unreasonable Conditions and a Case for Non-Convexity
papers.tldr: New guarantees remove a restrictive incoherence requirement and show support-recovery advantages for nonconvex sparse-plus-group-sparse models.

papers.title: StingyCD: Safely Avoiding Wasteful Updates in Coordinate Descent
papers.tldr: StingyCD speeds coordinate descent by skipping provably unproductive updates, while StingyCD+ skips more aggressively for further gains.

papers.title: Stochastic DCA for the Large-sum of Non-convex Functions Problem and its Application to Group Variable Selection in Classification
papers.tldr: A stochastic difference-of-convex algorithm uses inexpensive explicit projections for group-variable selection and performs favorably in multiclass classification experiments.

papers.title: Strong NP-Hardness for Sparse Optimization with Concave Penalty Functions
papers.tldr: A broad class of non-convex sparse optimization problems remains strongly NP-hard even under the specified approximation tolerances.

papers.title: A Screening Rule for l1-Regularized Ising Model Estimation
papers.tldr: A closed-form screening rule exactly identifies blocks in l1-regularized Ising solutions and can accelerate estimation when sufficient sparsity is present.

papers.title: A Sharp Error Analysis for the Fused Lasso, with Application to Approximate Changepoint Screening
papers.tldr: Under sparse changepoints, the paper establishes a fused-lasso error rate within a log log n factor of the minimax rate.

papers.title: A Universal Analysis of Large-Scale Regularized Least Squares Solutions
papers.tldr: The paper establishes when large-scale LASSO and other regularized least-squares solutions share asymptotic behavior across different random measurement distributions.

papers.title: Dykstra's Algorithm, ADMM, and Coordinate Descent: Connections, Insights, and Extensions
papers.tldr: Exact connections between coordinate descent, Dykstra's algorithm, and special cases of ADMM yield convergence insights and parallel algorithms.

papers.title: Efficient Sublinear-Regret Algorithms for Online Sparse Linear Regression with Limited Observation
papers.tldr: Under additional assumptions, efficient online regression algorithms achieve sublinear regret while observing only a limited number of features.

papers.title: Generalized Linear Model Regression under Distance-to-set Penalties
papers.tldr: Squared-distance penalties provide a flexible approach to constrained generalized linear models, with convergent optimization algorithms and strong reported empirical performance.

papers.title: Group Sparse Additive Machine
papers.tldr: GroupSAM brings group-sparse additive modeling to classification, with a polynomial learning-rate bound and supportive experiments.

papers.title: Parametric Simplex Method for Sparse Learning
papers.tldr: The parametric simplex method efficiently traces regularization paths for sparse linear programs, with sparsity guarantees under sufficient conditions.

papers.title: Regularized Modal Regression with Applications in Cognitive Impairment Prediction
papers.tldr: Regularized modal regression combines robust estimation and variable selection, with a reported improvement in cognitive impairment prediction.

papers.title: An Iterative, Sketching-based Framework for Ridge Regression
papers.tldr: An iterative sketching method approximates ridge regression with sampling guarantees tied to effective degrees of freedom rather than matrix dimensions.

papers.title: Approximate Leave-One-Out for Fast Parameter Tuning in High Dimensions
papers.tldr: Two primal and dual frameworks efficiently approximate leave-one-out risk for tuning penalized regression, including models with nonsmooth components.

papers.title: Celer: a Fast Solver for the Lasso with Dual Extrapolation
papers.tldr: Celer accelerates Lasso optimization by constructing better dual points that improve stopping criteria, feature screening, and working set selection.

papers.title: MSplit LBI: Realizing Feature Selection and Dense Estimation Simultaneously in Few-shot and Zero-shot Learning
papers.tldr: MSplit LBI jointly selects strong features and estimates dense weak signals, with reported benefits for few-shot and zero-shot learning.

papers.title: The Well-Tempered Lasso

papers.title: WHInter: A Working set algorithm for High-dimensional sparse second order Interaction models
papers.tldr: WHInter efficiently selects working sets for sparse pairwise-interaction models on binary data, reporting substantially better scalability and roughly hundredfold speedups.

papers.title: An Improved Analysis of Alternating Minimization for Structured Multi-Response Regression
papers.tldr: A resampling-free analysis explains how alternating minimization can estimate structured multi-response regressions effectively even from random initialization.

papers.title: Analytic solution and stationary phase approximation for the Bayesian lasso and elastic net
papers.tldr: A Fourier-based reformulation enables accurate posterior approximations for Bayesian lasso and elastic net regression in higher dimensions.

papers.title: Bilevel learning of the Group Lasso structure

papers.title: Learning SMaLL Predictors

papers.title: Low-rank Interaction with Sparse Additive Effects Model for Large Data Frames

papers.title: Sample Efficient Stochastic Gradient Iterative Hard Thresholding Method for Stochastic Sparse Linear Regression with Limited Attribute Observation
papers.tldr: Sparse regression methods combine attribute exploration and exploitation to achieve strong conditional sample-complexity guarantees with limited observations.

papers.title: Wavelet regression and additive models for irregularly spaced data

papers.title: Bayesian Joint Spike-and-Slab Graphical Lasso
papers.tldr: Bayesian spike-and-slab extensions of joint graphical lasso combine adaptive shrinkage and sparse-model selection with reduced estimation bias.

papers.title: Learning Optimal Linear Regularizers

papers.title: Projection onto Minkowski Sums with Application to Constrained Learning

papers.title: Regularization in directable environments with application to Tetris

papers.title: Screening rules for Lasso with non-convex Sparse Regularizers

papers.title: Stochastic Iterative Hard Thresholding for Graph-structured Sparsity Optimization

papers.title: Trimming the $\ell_1$ Regularizer: Statistical Analysis, Optimization, and Applications to Deep Learning
papers.tldr: The paper analyzes trimmed ℓ1 regularization, develops a practical optimizer, and reports benefits for sparse estimation and two deep learning tasks.

papers.title: Fast, Provably convergent IRLS Algorithm for p-norm Linear Regression
papers.tldr: p-IRLS provides geometric convergence for p-norm regression with finite p ≥ 2 and strong empirical speed in high-accuracy solving.

papers.title: Fast Sparse Group Lasso

papers.title: Handling correlated and repeated measurements with the smoothed multivariate square-root Lasso

papers.title: Iterative Least Trimmed Squares for Mixed Linear Regression

papers.title: Primal-Dual Block Generalized Frank-Wolfe

papers.title: Sparse High-Dimensional Isotonic Regression

papers.title: Statistical-Computational Tradeoff in Single Index Models

papers.title: Exact expressions for double descent and implicit regularization via surrogate random design

papers.title: The Complete Lasso Tradeoff Diagram

papers.title: The Strong Screening Rule for SLOPE

papers.title: Robust Inference for High-Dimensional Linear Models via Residual Randomization

papers.title: Robust Regression Revisited: Acceleration and Improved Estimation Rates

papers.title: Smooth Bilevel Programming for Sparse Regularization

papers.title: The Benefits of Implicit Regularization from SGD in Least Squares Problems

papers.title: Active Nearest Neighbor Regression Through Delaunay Refinement

papers.tldr: Reductions connect robust and sparse regression, yielding hardness results and algorithms whose runtimes approach a conditional lower bound.

papers.title: Sparsity in Partially Controllable Linear Systems

papers.title: Information bottleneck theory of high-dimensional regression: relevancy, efficiency and optimality

papers.title: Provably tuning the ElasticNet across instances

papers.title: The Hessian Screening Rule

papers.title: Gradient Descent Converges Linearly for Logistic Regression on Separable Data

papers.title: An Iterative Min-Min Optimization Method for Sparse Bayesian Learning

papers.title: Regression Learning with Limited Observations of Multivariate Outcomes and Features

papers.title: Scale-invariant Optimal Sampling for Rare-events Data and Sparse Models

papers.title: Projection Pursuit Density Ratio Estimation
